description: She wears an opaque deep blue floor length court gown, with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow length sleeves. Dense gold floral and geometric embroidery decorates the front, sleeves, cuffs and skirt borders. A cream underdress shows at the central skirt panel and sleeve edges. A heavy blue shoulder layer with cream lining rests around her forearms and hangs beside the skirt. A decorated belt with round metal details circles the waist. Her hands rest together in front and brown leather boots show below the hem; her head is bare.
